{questions}

tradeoffs: C loses 0.52 seconds of viewing time on the final proof image, so viewers have slightly less time to inspect it.
The improvement is predicted from audit judgments, not demonstrated by audience retention data.
proposal.why_smallest: It removes only the identified dead pause while preserving the wording, story order, narration, captions, music, opening, and payoff footage before that pause. proposal.selector_reason: Both independent audits identify the unchanged final hold as the sole visible defect, while the comparison finds A and B equivalent on every measured dimension. Trimming A’s final 0.52-second pause directly addresses that shared low-severity weakness without altering what already works.
